description: A composite figure of five rows (a–e, steels S1–S5) and three columns, combining dilatometry with light-optical microscopy (LOM). Left column: heating RLC–T curves (black; RLC in %, left axis, Temperature in °C from 600 to 1100 °C, or 600–1200 °C for S3) with first derivatives d(RLC)/dT (red, right axis, °C⁻¹); vertical dashed lines mark the operational TA = 1052 °C (S1), 1031 °C (S2), 1067 °C (S4) and 900 °C (S5), whereas panel (c) carries no TA value, only the annotation "Broadened austenitizing transition". Middle column: LOM at 1050 °C, all with 100 µm scale bars; only S2 is tagged "αp - free", while S1, S3, S4 and S5 still show light polygonal ferrite, with small dark-field insets of white αp particles in the S4 and S5 panels. Right column: LOM at the selected TA — 1150 °C for S1, S2, S4 and S5 (S1 and S2 labelled "αp - free") and 1220 °C for S3, where residual αp is marked by labelled arrows. The three columns together argue that the dilatometric TA criterion, LOM-verified, eliminates polygonal ferrite in S1, S2, S4 and S5, but not in the high-Al S3.

observations.observation: The figure is a 5-row × 3-column composite; rows (a)–(e) correspond to steels S1–S5, columns being dilatometry, LOM at 1050 °C, and LOM at the selected TA.
Left-column plots use two axes: RLC (%) in black on the left and d(RLC)/dT (°C⁻¹) in red on the right, with Temperature (°C) on the abscissa (600–1100 °C; 600–1200 °C for S3).
Printed vertical dashed-line TA values read TA = 1052 °C (panel a, S1), TA = 1031 °C (panel b, S2), TA = 1067 °C (panel d, S4) and TA = 900 °C (panel e, S5).
Panel (c) for S3 has no printed TA number; it carries the rotated annotation 'Broadened austenitizing transition' with the dashed line near 880 °C.
Every LOM image carries a 100 µm scale bar.
In the middle (1050 °C) column only S2 is boxed as 'αp - free'; the S1, S3, S4 and S5 panels show visibly retained light polygonal ferrite.
Right-column LOM temperatures are printed as 1150 °C for S1, S2, S4 and S5 and 1220 °C for S3; the S1 and S2 panels are boxed 'αp - free', while αp is label-arrowed in S3, S4 and S5.
The middle LOM panel of row (e) is labelled 'S4- TA: 1050 °C', duplicating the row-(d) S4 label, although the caption assigns row (e) to steel S5.
Dark-field insets showing bright white αp particles against black appear in the 1050 °C panels of S4 and S5.
The caption states that αp is eliminated in S1 and S2 and reduced to trace levels in S4 and S5 at the selected TA, whereas S3 retains a noticeable αp fraction even at elevated TA.
The caption states that S3 uses a selected TA of 1220 °C while S1, S2, S4 and S5 use 1150 °C.

The citing text gives derivative-based approximate TA values of 1062 °C (S1), 1031 °C (S2), 1067 °C (S4) and ~900 °C (S5), with a broadened transition and no unique TA for S3; the S1 value conflicts with the 1052 °C printed in panel (a) — reported here as both readings, low confidence.
The citing text reports αp area fractions of ~14.6 % for S3 at 1050 °C and ~8.2 % at 1220 °C, and trace αp levels (<1 %) for S4 and ≲1 % for S5 at 1150 °C.
The caption describes the operational TA as the temperature where the first-derivative peak decays and linearity of the RLC base curve is first restored, marked by the vertical dashed line.
The RLC axis range differs between rows: 0.5–3.5 % (S1) and 0.5–4.0 % (S2) versus tighter 0.0–1.4 % (S3), 0.0–1.6 % (S4) and 0.0–2.5 % (S5), indicating a much smaller overall length change for S3–S5.

subfigures.description: Dilatometric heating curve of S1: RLC (%) vs Temperature 600–1100 °C (left axis 0.5–3.5 %), red derivative d(RLC)/dT (right axis 0.002–0.006 °C⁻¹) with two peaks; vertical dashed line labelled TA = 1052 °C and a horizontal dashed reference line near RLC ≈ 2.4 %.
LOM of S1 at TA: 1050 °C, 100 µm scale bar, light-etched ferritic/martensitic matrix with scattered light-coloured polygonal ferrite; no 'αp-free' tag.
LOM of S1 at TA: 1150 °C, 100 µm scale bar, uniform dark-etched microstructure, boxed label 'αp - free'.
Dilatometric curve of S2, RLC 0.5–4.0 % (left) and d(RLC)/dT 0.002–0.006 °C⁻¹ (right) over 600–1100 °C; vertical dashed line labelled TA = 1031 °C.
LOM of S2 at TA: 1050 °C, 100 µm scale bar, boxed label 'αp - free'.
LOM of S2 at TA: 1150 °C, 100 µm scale bar, boxed label 'αp - free'.

Dilatometric curve of S3 over 600–1200 °C, RLC 0.0–1.4 % (left) and d(RLC)/dT 0.001–0.003 °C⁻¹ (right); broad multi-peak derivative, vertical dashed line near 880 °C and the vertical annotation 'Broadened austenitizing transition'; no numeric TA printed.
LOM of S3 at TA: 1050 °C, 100 µm scale bar, showing abundant light polygonal ferrite islands in a dark matrix.
LOM of S3 at TA: 1220 °C, 100 µm scale bar, still showing a clear amount of light polygonal ferrite in the dark etched matrix.

Dilatometric curve of S4 over 600–1100 °C, RLC 0.0–1.6 % (left) and d(RLC)/dT 0.000–0.003 °C⁻¹ (right); vertical dashed line labelled TA = 1067 °C and horizontal dashed reference line near RLC ≈ 1.1 %.
LOM of S4 at TA: 1050 °C, 100 µm scale bar, light-etched matrix with a dark-field inset (bottom-left) showing white αp particles on a black background.
LOM of S4 at TA: 1150 °C, 100 µm scale bar, dark-etched matrix with bright αp particles indicated by labelled arrows ('αp').

Dilatometric curve of S5 over 600–1100 °C, RLC 0.0–2.5 % (left) and d(RLC)/dT 0.001–0.005 °C⁻¹ (right) with two sharp derivative peaks; vertical dashed line labelled TA = 900 °C and horizontal dashed reference line near RLC ≈ 0.65 %.

LOM labelled 'S4- TA: 1050 °C' (row e panel is printed as S4, duplicating the row-d label), 100 µm scale bar, light-etched matrix with dark needles/platelets and a dark-field inset of white particles.
LOM of S5 at TA: 1150 °C, 100 µm scale bar, dark-etched matrix with small bright αp particles marked by labelled arrows ('αp').

unreadable_items: Panel (c) (S3): no numeric TA value is printed — only the annotation 'Broadened austenitizing transition'; the dashed line position (~880 °C) was read from the axis.
Row (e) middle LOM is labelled 'S4- TA: 1050 °C', an apparent label duplication/error for S5; the micrograph itself cannot be verified against the caption's S5 assignment.
Small inset dark-field images in the S4/S5 1050 °C panels have no scale bar or printed particle-size values.
Red derivative sub-peak positions in panels (a), (b) and (e) are not numerically labelled; only approximate positions relative to axis gridlines can be given.
